result.reason: The first sentence reaches the preferred position, but the Order Form exception reintroduces a volume commitment and conflicts with both that sentence and Section 12.3’s categorical no-minimum-volume acknowledgement. Although the exception includes the 12-month and 30-day reduction protections, it does not clearly provide the required true-up: a shortfall cannot coherently be treated as a carry-forward credit when no shortfall payment is due, and a carry-forward to a later period conflicts with termination or expiry of the commitment. The fallback machinery is unnecessary if the preferred no-commitment position is retained. The margin comment does not cure these operative ambiguities.
